hero.description: Vail Lake and Palomar Mountain as seen from Oak Mountain. This image was captured in the Inland Hills EPA Level IV Ecoregion (85l). The Southern California Lower Montane Shrub and Woodland EPA Level IV Ecoregion (8e) occurs on lower portions of Palomar Mountain and the Southern California Montane Conifer Forest EPA Level IV Ecoregion (8f) occurs on the higher areas of Palomar Mountain. In One Earth's ecoregion framework, this image captures the California Coastal Sage and Chaparral Ecoregion ecotone with the California Montane Chaparral and Woodlands Ecoregion occurring in the distance.
